title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program Terms — One Membership per Customer
content:
**Clause.** A customer holds at most 1 Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership. A new membership is opened only when the customer has no other membership in active or suspended status. A closed membership is never reopened: a customer whose membership was cancelled may enroll again and starts a new membership as Finch Circle Member (or at a card-floor tier) with zero points, no notes and no enrollment bonus, while a customer whose membership was closed by termination after a program review may not enroll again. Points, notes and alteration credit never move between memberships or between members, and household members each hold their own membership.

**Basis of the check.** Whether another membership exists is read from the company's membership records for the same customer — the customer the enrollment is for — and from the status those records show. A membership in active or suspended status blocks a new one; a closed membership does not, except that a membership closed by termination bars enrolling again.

## The clause by status of the earlier membership

| Earlier membership of the same customer | New enrollment | What the new membership starts with |
|---|---|---|
| None | allowed | — |
| Active | not allowed | — |
| Suspended | not allowed | — |
| Closed by the member's own cancellation | allowed | Finch Circle Member (or a card-floor tier), zero points, no notes, no enrollment bonus |
| Closed by termination after a program review | not allowed | — |

## Points of judgement

- **Can a closed membership be reopened instead of opening a new one?** No. A closed membership is never reopened; where enrolling again is allowed, it is a new membership.
- **Can points move to a spouse's membership in the same household?** No. Points, notes and alteration credit never move between memberships or between members, and each household member holds their own membership.
- **Does a cancelled former member get the enrollment bonus again?** No. The new membership starts with zero points, no notes and no enrollment bonus.
